title: Affine linear form and homogenization
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $a_0\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $a_1,\ldots,a_n\in\mathbb{R}$. On the Boolean cube of sign vectors, the squared uniform $L^2$ norm of the affine form $a_0+\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$ equals the squared uniform $L^2$ norm of the homogeneous linear form on the $(n+1)$-dimensional cube with coefficients $(a_0,a_1,\ldots,a_n)$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ assigns a real coefficient to each index in $\{1,\ldots,n\}$
